newsitem.title: USA: UCAR at ease with $3.60/shr 1997 estimate.
newsitem.headline: UCAR at ease with $3.60/shr 1997 estimate.

text.p: UCAR International Inc is comfortable with an analyst's earnings estimate of $3.60 a share for 1997, UCAR Chief Executive Officer Robert Krass said Tuesday.
"We're comfortable with what these guys are saying," Krass told Reuters after speaking to the annual Robinson-Humphrey institutional conference.
Three weeks ago, the Robinson-Humphrey analyst who follows the graphite manufacturer issued a report forecasting earnings of $3.60 a share for the year.
During his presentation to analysts, Krass described his industry as one of slow growth. He said improvements would come primarily from "cost reduction as opposed to price increases."
He said UCAR's cash flow would amount to about $150 million this year and would be used for expansion and a stock buyback program, not debt reduction.
For 1996, UCAR posted earnings of $3 a share, before the effect of an accounting change.
